notes: Time-based programs need at least 2,000 hours of on-the-job learning under a work process schedule. Competency-based programs set no hour count and must state the competencies and how each is tested. Hybrid programs combine minimum hours with demonstrated competency. A minimum of 144 hours of related instruction per year is recommended. Probation is capped at 25 percent of program length or one year. Wages rise on a schedule tied to skill. Completers get a certificate from the Registration Agency; competency and hybrid programs may issue interim credentials.

name: Government Digital and Data Profession Capability Framework
body: UK Government Digital Service, Central Digital and Data Office
notes: Each role has ordered role levels; each role level lists skills at one of four skill levels: Awareness, Working, Practitioner, Expert. Software developer has nine role levels: apprentice developer, junior developer, developer, senior developer, senior developer management, lead developer, lead developer management, principal developer, principal developer management. The ladder forks into technical and management tracks from senior upward. This is the cleanest open-licence skill-by-level matrix found in this slice.

From memory: on-time graduation within 100 and 150 percent of program length, in-field employment at 90 and 180 days, median salary, and a mandatory accounting of every enrolled student. Membership shrank after 2020; many large bootcamps stopped reporting.

Outcome claim: 70 percent or more of US graduates report a positive career outcome within six months, from a 2025 program graduate survey; the FAQ on the same page says 75 percent.
